Account summary: UK-based legaltech platform that powers search and discovery across law firm content (precedents, contracts, case notes). Primary constraint: UK data residency for sensitive legal records; also GDPR. Multi-region failover required (London primary, Frankfurt passive) but primary residency must remain in UK.

Scale & technical profile: currently ~150M documents (mix of briefs, scanned PDFs OCRed, client memos). Estimated ~120M vectors for production index (1536-d). Peak query load target: 60-80 QPS during working hours; steady-state 8-12 QPS. P99 latency target for end-to-end search (embed+ANN+rerank) <200ms within UK region. Cost sensitivity: target <$0.01 per query (embedding+rerank amortized).

Architecture preferences & constraints: want coarse ANN (HNSW) on vector store + GPU-accelerated re-ranker for top-10. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization to reduce unit costs. Prefer Dedicated capacity in UK region with automated routing to EU (Frankfurt) on failure; fallback to hosted API only for short bursts. Must integrate with customer SSO (SAML), KMS-backed keys (HSM preferred), full audit logs, and 1+ year retention controls.

POC plan: 1) sample index 15M docs (subset) & baseline with current stack; 2) measure embedding throughput and cost, ANN latency at scale, and rerank GPU latency for 10-rerank pipeline; 3) SLOs: 95th <80ms; 99th <200ms for UK region; failover <5s to EU; cost target <€0.01/query. POC timeline currently scoped for 4 weeks once DPA & infra whitelisting complete.
